snippets.text: Position: EHR Security Analyst/ Application Support Specialist

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: The EHR Security Analyst is responsible for managing and help define user access policies, security policies and role-based permissions within the EHR.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: This role will work closely with the EHR Application team, ISO Team and HIPAA compliance officer among others to ensure that the application is compliance with HIPAA standards, organizational security policies and best practices.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: · Map and maintaining EHR positions definitions, which includes, Millenium Positions, Preferences and OHPAC Security groups with VDH Positions.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: · Monitor and enforce appropriate use of EHR Access Control Positions and Policies, ensuring that users have the correct level of access based on their roles and their job functions.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: · Work with EHR Security Officer, IT Technical team, Support Team and EHR Core team to help define and automate user provisioning and offboarding procedures.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Monitor and conduct internal security audits of the EHR application to identify and mitigate risks and/or vulnerabilities detected.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Work with EHR Security Officer to develop and maintain security policies, procedure and guidelines related to the Application.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Work with EHR Security Officer and ISO Office and EHR Core team to define and complete security documentation and downtime procedures according with VDH Security guidelines.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Work with EHR Security Officer to respond and investigate security incidents related to EHR Application ensuring timely resolution and proper reporting to stakeholders.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Collaborate with the EHR implementation and optimization teams to ensure that security measures are integrated into the deployment of new features, updates, and third-party applications.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Stay informed about emerging security threats, technologies, and best practices related to EHR systems.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Recommend improvements and optimizations to the EHR security environment based on industry trends and emerging threats.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Monitor user behavior by using tools like P2Sentinel to determine trends and possible incidents.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Work with EHR Security Officer and EHR Core team to assist on internal and external audits.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Participate in Cerner/OHPAC upgrades, security patches and system maintenance to ensure ongoing security.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Participate in the Domain Strategy for EHR Application.

snippets.title: Security Analyst
snippets.text: ·Stay up to date with security updates, best practices and regulatory changes.
